Recent feed/archive items were checked as secondary discovery only. No article was accepted on JournalFeed alone; recent highlighted items with older first-online dates were not treated as new.
Current ACEP clinical policies and dated official-domain results were checked; no new in-window clinical policy was identified.

AHA/ASA guideline and scientific-statement pages plus dated searches were checked. The 2026 acute ischemic stroke guideline predates this recovery window; no newer in-window acute-care statement was identified.
ACC guideline pages and dated searches were checked; no new in-window ED-facing guideline meeting the publication threshold was identified.
AAP guideline pages were checked. The September 28 pediatric UTI guideline is already a current EM Weekly article; no additional in-window major pediatric emergency guideline was identified.
ACS trauma best-practice pages and dated searches were checked; no new in-window bedside trauma guideline was identified.
ENA practice resources and dated searches were checked; no clearly dated new in-window clinical guidance meeting the threshold was identified.
SAEM GRACE guidance was checked; the latest listed GRACE guideline remains from 2025, with no new in-window GRACE publication.
AAEM statements and dated official-domain results were checked. Recent October material was administrative/workforce focused rather than new bedside clinical guidance.

ASH guidance was checked. The 2026 immune thrombocytopenia guidance first appeared online August 19, 2026, before this recovery interval, and is not a new acute severe-bleeding guideline; the queued item was rejected for current publication.
CHEST guideline pages and dated searches were checked; no new in-window acute ED guideline meeting the threshold was identified.

SCCM and Surviving Sepsis Campaign guidance pages were checked. The 2026 adult and pediatric sepsis guidelines are already historical/backfill records and predate this recovery window; no new in-window update was identified.

IDSA current practice-guideline pages were checked. Recently identified S. aureus bacteremia, histoplasmosis, and pediatric COVID updates were first online before September 27; no new in-window ED-priority guidance was identified.
ACMT statements were checked; no new in-window toxicology position/practice statement meeting the clinical threshold was identified.
EAST current PMGs were checked. The 2026 BCVI page is labeled a guideline under development rather than a final publication; it remains held for future review.
ESO guideline pages and dated searches were checked; no new in-window guideline was identified.
ACOG clinical guidance and dated obstetric-emergency searches were checked; no new in-window ED-facing obstetric guideline meeting the threshold was identified.
ERC guideline pages were checked; the current resuscitation guideline set remains the 2025 edition, with no new 2026 in-window guideline identified.
